actual_request.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a NEW monochrome motif revision directly from the attached approved original colored chess knight illustration A-r01. The output is a simplified SILHOUETTE illustration for a future 24 columns x 36 rows nonogram, NOT a raster. Keep the EXACT original object identity, LEFT-facing side profile, lowered long muzzle, TWO original pointed ear tips and the WHITE exterior space between them, original arched neck, original outer mane curve and the connected stepped circular chess pedestal. Preserve original placement and overall proportions on the same square white canvas, object entirely uncropped. The approved color original is a reference and remains unchanged as a separate file. Make the ENTIRE object one continuous SOLID BLACK filled silhouette: horse head, ears, mane, neck and stepped base all filled black, with WHITE background outside. Preserve the LARGE WHITE EXTERIOR CONCAVITY under the muzzle and along the front of the curved neck. Preserve the natural SMALL EXTERIOR INDENT at the mouth/chin if it belongs to the outer outline; do not draw the internal mouth slit. Remove ALL internal details and all interior white decoration: NO eye, nostril, inner ear holes, facial lines, cheek highlight, interior mouth line, internal mane grooves, white neck stripe, white pedestal tier stripes, outlines-with-white-interior, hatching, wood grain, shading, highlights, cast ground shadow, grey fill or gradients. The base tiers are expressed ONLY by the original outside edge profile and neck constrictions. Smooth clean coherent gently hand-drawn contour, quiet series style, silhouette must be recognizable as the SAME specific carved chess knight, not a generic horse head or a redesigned logo. Do not add artificial details or change the head angle, size, proportions, curvature or base geometry. No cell grid, pixel staircase, numbers, hints, captions, watermark, additional objects or panels.
